name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-05-29, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
